content.short: Upbit is South Korea's largest crypto exchange by volume, run by Dunamu, with KRW markets, NFTs and staking.
content.description: Upbit leads trading volume among Korean exchanges and is among the biggest spot venues in Asia. Korean users trade a long list of assets against the won, while regional versions serve Singapore, Indonesia and Thailand. Besides trading, Upbit runs an NFT marketplace and staking for supported assets. Its operator, Dunamu, also runs other financial services in Korea. Beyond trading, Upbit offers recurring buys, lending, a custody service and DataLab market research, and publishes indices such as the Upbit Composite Index.
